name: Case 1 · Snatch
blurb: Market Mile, dusk. A bridge engineer is dragged off a bike taxi into a van.

beats.narration: You were a patrol officer walking the fruit lanes. You knew every stall by the fruit they would not sell you.

beats.text: I grew up two streets over. My mother sold plantain at Stall 14. When the Kites started snatching kids off bike taxis, everybody looked to the police. The police looked away.
My cousin Nkem was thirteen. Her case is still open. Cold, they call it. So I put in for detective. Then INTERCEPT. Then here.
Induction day. The unit that catches them before it goes cold.
Rookie. Callsign Rook. You wanted the unit that catches them before it goes cold. Welcome. Try not to become a cold case yourself before lunchtime.
An earpiece for the new detective. Sightline reads the city pulse and whispers where they will run next. Trust it. It has been right nine times out of ten this month.
Rook — radio. Snatch in progress, Market Mile, corner of the fruit lane. Bike taxi, red van, three masked. We are moving.

lines.text: The van cuts off a bike taxi at the mouth of the fruit lane. Masked Kites haul Funmi Adeyinka inside. Doors slam. Engine already running.
"Rook — go! I'm on the wheel, you're on the ground. MOVE."

scenes.win_text: The goon goes down over a crate of oranges. His delivery cart is still standing, two stalls back.
Panels shed bricks across the junction. You wrench the doors open. Empty — Funmi was switched to a bike mid-chase.

scenes.prompt: Kemi Hart is live-streaming you. 12.4k watching.

left.label: Give her an exclusive
left.result: She cuts the live feed and walks with you instead.
left.echo: Kemi is an ally. The city stays calmer, and her tips open doors in Case 2.

right.label: Seize her phone
right.result: She films the seizure on a second phone. It is online before you reach the car.
right.echo: Kemi is a rival. She will reach your next crime scene before you do.

hesitate.label: You hesitated
hesitate.result: Dash steps in and takes the phone himself. Nobody looks good.
hesitate.echo: Hesitation is its own answer, and the squad noticed.

scenes.title: You lost the victim
scenes.text: Commander Ife: "First day, and you lost her." That night, INTERCEPT launches. Ada Voss hands the unit Sightline — "It tells you where they are going before they know it themselves."
scenes.cliff: The caught Kite leans into the glass: "You did not lose her. You were shown where to look."
